scope: Read-only review of the saved R3 accounting, its analyzer/source mapping, and five raw term records near sequence 35615. No model, solver, build, or full-spectrum reread was performed.

reviewed_accounting.sole_file_header_difference: TAPE6-confirmed HTIME word 168; physical header words match

raw_term_spot_checks.method: Read only sequential records from the saved trace through seq 35610, 35613, 35615, 35616, and 35617; decoded the 15 int64 and 22 float64 fields using the source writer layout in udm37_r3_term. No model or full output parsing.

source_interpretation.line_strength_and_ratio: oprop.f90 LNCOR1 computes SP=SUI*(1+GI*PAVP2), SPPI=SUI*YI*PAVP0, and SPPSP=SPPI/SP (around lines 1157-1159); the line-store hook follows. For this selected CO2 coupling line, GI=0, so the line-strength multiplier is exactly 1 and SP=SUI. SPPSP is positive (about 1.043), not the source of the negative sign.
source_interpretation.R3_update: CNVFNV first adds the baseline R3 term STRF3*F3 (around line 1330), then for nonzero SPPSP scales STRF3 by CLC3*SPPSP and adds STRF3*F3*ZF3L (around lines 1339-1364). The sampled coupling update is negative because ZF3L is negative while scaled STRF3 and F3 are positive. This identifies the local line-coupling increment, not an independent physical cause for all negative optical depth.
source_interpretation.source_hook: The diagnostic writer serializes the fields passed at the two R3 writes and validates saved line metadata VNU against the term. The inherited full PANEL trace and all45 output samples/panel headers remained bitwise unchanged except the recorded runtime clock word.

target_r3_index_63_accounting.qualification: The per-write ordered chain is checked bitwise in the saved analyzer; component fsum totals are descriptive. Positive carry/baseline/continuum terms do not offset the negative sum.

conclusion_and_limits: The saved trace supports a local causal statement: in this CPL run and selected layer-21 R3 window, CO2 lines with the coupling flag make negative R3 increments through the SPPSP-controlled coupling branch; the selected large crossing is a positive-SPPSP line with negative signed ZF3L, not a GI line-strength effect.

The original negative-OD physical-reference acceptance remains FAIL_NEGATIVE_OD_RETAINED. This accounting does not establish global spectroscopy validity, explain every negative sample, prove an underlying physical defect, or establish WRF4/37 flux attribution or UDM accuracy.

Saved v2 analysis reports bitwise exact full-spectrum output equivalence for all45 layers against the uninstrumented CPL run; this is evidence of instrumentation noninterference, not a pass of the physical nonnegative-OD gate.
